import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# --- [CELL 3]: ---

cols = ['LOAN',
        'MORTDUE',
        'VALUE',
        'YOJ',
        'DEROG',
        'DELINQ',
        'CLAGE',
        'NINQ',
        'CLNO']
dd={}


for col in cols:

    freq, edges = np.histogram(df[col].values)

    freq, edges = np.histogram(g.get_group('DEFAULT')[col].values, bins=edges)
